name: Active Member
description: Regularly participates in training, matches/events, and club activities; full voting rights and priority for selection.

name: Supporting Member
description: Contributes to the club (financially or otherwise) without regular active participation; may join activities as space allows.

name: Guest / Trial Member
description: Attends on a temporary basis to assess fit, subject to the same conduct standards as full members.
friendlies: Yes — as needed, esp. for evaluation
